summary.source: Fresh Session 82 live-code audit with product, game-loop, browser UX, public-app release, rendered-pixel, privacy, observability-honesty, and Studio protocol lenses. Every selected premise was checked against current source, tests, live doctor output, current hosted provenance, and the read-only specialty reviews.
summary.qualityBar: L2 by default: one canonical authority, player-visible payoff for gameplay changes, focused behavioral tests, exact dark/light desktop/mobile rendered proof for touched UI, current Web Vitals evidence, exact-candidate staging before direct-main publication, and launchReady preserved false.

profile.rubric: product rubric plus game-medium overlay: vivid General Manager agency, explicit irreversible boundaries, progression hierarchy, browser-visible feedback, accessibility, privacy, static/local-first behavior, and public-app release gates
profile.staging: stable Cloudflare Pages must prove the exact immutable candidate before direct-to-main publication; backend deployment is required only when backend source changes
profile.source: arc-profile registry authority, Session 82 startup brief, 29,981-token code sample, exact grep/read preverification, game-loop review, app-release gate matrix, browser boot/reachability probes, canon conformance, and doctor

gameLoopReview.evidence: Code-contract review only. No consented cohort or docs/PLAYTESTS evidence exists, and public SOUL intentionally withholds private criteria, so these scores do not claim measured fun, retention, or complete private-soul conformance.

releaseGate.deploymentVerdict: REVERIFY AFTER IMPLEMENTATION — current staging and production are exact at d0d2b617/ad62bc26, but Session 82 deployable work must earn a new exact-revision receipt.
releaseGate.launchVerdict: NO-GO — deployment authorization does not permit a public launch flip.
launchHolds: SHA-bound public-launch approval distinct from deploy authorization
current exact-revision Core Web Vitals, edge, and rendered-theme evidence

recommendedMoves: Make every authority boundary honest before adding breadth: session identity cannot reverse, and irreversible draft-pick trades require an explicit review boundary.
Close the evidence gap around the weekly loop by retaining review, revision, defer, commit, and debrief checkpoints without publishing local instrumentation as cohort proof.

Unify the player's progression hierarchy and release truth: one Architect Objective should connect the current mastery focus to an exact destination, while hosted performance and structured release receipts remain exact-revision authorities.

preverifiedSkips.reason: False premise. Immediate commands, season chapters, mastery paths, and Trophy Road already exist; the verified gap is their hierarchy, not missing breadth.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected. Email, lifecycle, founder approval, exact hosted performance, and exact visual authority are independent gates.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected by the static/local-first and free-tier cost bars. Existing deterministic authorities can close every verified gap without variable spend.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Founder-direction-gated in the durable decision record; this audit cannot invent terminal product canon.

items.title: Prevent startup generation from moving session authority backward
executionEvidence: canonical startup renderer advanced to Session 82 without lowering PROJECT_STATUS
npm test aggregate 1067/1067 before receipt-only tooling refinements
items.premise: Session 81 is bound in PROJECT_STATUS and the latest handoff/receipts, but SIL closes only through Session 80. The startup renderer treats SIL as exclusive authority, computed S81 as next, and wrote PROJECT_STATUS.currentSession from 81 back to 80. This violates arc's monotonic-forward identity contract and can misfile every S82 write-back surface.
evidence: scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs currentSession and canonical self-heal logic
items.constraint: Session identity may advance from any committed authority but never reverse; noncanonical test renders remain write-free; divergent authorities must render an explicit diagnostic rather than silently normalize downward.
verification: focused renderer authority tests cover status ahead, SIL ahead, equal, and unparseable cases
S82 startup brief and last-session summary bind to S81

L1.recipe: Clamp current and next session identity to the maximum parseable committed SIL/status/handoff authority and remove downward self-heal.

L2.recipe: Extract a pure monotonic session-authority resolver, parse structured handoff/status evidence, allow only upward canonical repair, emit explicit divergence diagnostics, and regression-test every authority ordering.

L3.recipe: L2 plus derive authority from git-bound closeout fingerprints and produce a machine-readable reconciliation receipt consumed by start and closeout.

items.category: Game-loop safety / irreversible agency / UI UX
items.title: Give live-pick trades an explicit review-and-commit boundary
executionEvidence: exact candidate dark/light desktop/mobile/tablet review pixels passed
items.premise: The live on-clock market discloses assets and values, but Accept and Counter immediately invoke the irreversible ownership transfer. A single pointer event can trade the controlled live selection and cause the rival to consume the slot, while ordinary drafting already uses a deliberate reveal boundary.
evidence: public/app.js draftWarRoomPanel handler posts on first click
src/runtime/GameSession.js resolveOnClockTrade commits assets and consumes the slot
items.constraint: Review must show exact outgoing/incoming picks, disclosed values, rival target, action type, irreversibility, and stale fingerprint; Decline remains one-step and non-mutating; confirmation may never invent acceptance odds or urgency.
verification: first Accept/Counter interaction performs no API mutation and opens an accessible review dialog
Confirm posts the exact fingerprint once; Cancel returns focus and leaves state untouched
stale, counter-declined, success, keyboard, desktop/mobile dark/light states are covered

L1.recipe: Use a native confirmation step that names the exact offer before Accept or Counter posts.

L2.recipe: Build one accessible shared live-pick trade review dialog with exact asset/value/fingerprint disclosure, explicit irreversible language, cancel/focus restoration, and a single guarded confirm seam for Accept and Counter.

L3.recipe: L2 plus persist a pre-commit review receipt and join the accepted transaction to the Draft Anthology without creating a second trade ledger.

items.category: Feedback loop / playtest truth / retention evidence
items.title: Retain the weekly-plan review, revision, and defer evidence the composer already emits
executionEvidence: schema 1.1 planning-friction summary preserves local-only no-cohort boundary
items.premise: weeklyPlanComposer emits weekly-plan-reviewed, weekly-plan-revision-requested, and weekly-plan-deferred, but playtestJourney silently rejects all three because its allowlist omits them. Local exports therefore cannot diagnose whether Architect review sharpened a plan, caused a revision, or ended the attempt.
evidence: public/app.js passes composer checkpoints into the journey ledger
items.constraint: Events remain local until explicit sharing, relative-time-only, bounded, allowlisted, account/token/save-free, and never become cohort or retention claims.
verification: review, revise, defer, commit and debrief events survive the allowlist
duplicate and unknown events remain suppressed and the bound remains enforced
explicit receipt export labels local instrumentation as non-cohort evidence

L1.recipe: Add the three already-emitted planning checkpoints to the bounded allowlist and tests.

L2.recipe: Version the journey schema, retain review/revision/defer checkpoints with relative deltas, add a bounded planning-friction summary to explicit local exports, and preserve the no-cohort warning.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a player-visible private journey review that can be selectively attached to feedback one receipt at a time.

items.title: Unify the player-authored mastery focus with the visible season and legacy horizon
executionEvidence: dark/light desktop and mobile Architect Objective pixels manually inspected with zero blocking defects
items.premise: Franchise Command, season chapters, mastery focus, and Trophy Road each publish a separate next objective. The existing three-horizon Architecture surface shows Now, Season, and generic GM Legacy, but its Legacy lane ignores the player's source-bound mastery focus even though that focus already has an exact next milestone and destination authority.
evidence: public/lib/franchiseArchitecture.js generic legacyLane and unused mastery in horizon construction
public/lib/tabOverview.js separate Command, Architecture, mastery, and Trophy Road surfaces
public/lib/achievements.js nearest measurable Trophy Road objectives
items.constraint: Do not create another progression score or hidden bonus. The hierarchy must preserve Now as dominant, label its source, use the active player-authored focus when present, fall back honestly, and route to an exact existing surface.
verification: three-horizon builder promotes player-authored mastery into a non-blocking Architect Objective
fallback, empty-evidence, season-chapter, and measurable-trophy inputs remain deterministic and honest
Overview and mobile dark/light pixels show one dominant command plus one subordinate objective hierarchy

L1.recipe: Replace the generic legacy milestone with the current mastery focus nextMilestone and Architecture Review destination.

L2.recipe: Derive one non-blocking Architect Objective from player-authored mastery focus first, active season chapter second, and nearest measurable Trophy Road milestone as supporting evidence; show source, exact destination, and no-hidden-bonus boundary on desktop and mobile.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a cross-season objective history joined to existing mastery receipts, with completion inferred only from canonical evidence changes.

items.title: Make exact-revision Web Vitals and edge evidence a reproducible release receipt
executionEvidence: public entry route median desktop LCP 556ms INP 24ms CLS 0.0151
direct game-shell hydration retained separately as a red diagnostic
items.premise: Boot bytes, module reachability, responsive captures, staging provenance, and production parity are automated, but the app-release gate still has no current staging LCP/INP/CLS measurement and health reports hosted edge policy unobserved. The launch gate therefore cannot distinguish visual correctness from interaction/performance readiness.
items.constraint: Measure the stable staging origin at the exact candidate; never infer field metrics from static bytes; unavailable tooling or incomplete interaction samples are explicit skip/incomplete, not pass.
verification: machine-readable receipt binds source revision, artifact fingerprint, origin, LCP, CLS, INP/interaction status and edge headers
LCP is under the project 1.8s bar and CLS/interaction evidence names its threshold or incompleteness
release gate and status surfaces consume the current receipt without hand-copied claims

L1.recipe: Capture LCP and CLS plus edge headers from stable staging and record INP as incomplete when no qualifying interaction exists.

L2.recipe: Create a bounded exact-revision browser performance probe with a deliberate interaction, hash-bound JSON receipt, threshold verdicts, edge-header observation, and fail-closed release/status consumption.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a multi-route desktop/mobile performance budget history and regression comparison against the last promoted artifact.

items.title: Stop structured project status from carrying several stale release candidates at once
executionEvidence: release provenance and authority focused suite 9/9
one exact deployable candidate 046e35df plus artifact 656eb904 across staging, visual and performance receipts
source-bound edge-policy receipt excluded from deployable-content identity with regression coverage
production verifier intentionally remains pending until direct-main publication
items.premise: Fresh staging and production verifiers prove d0d2b617/ad62bc26, while PROJECT_STATUS top-level verification narrates c822ae85/94bebbd1 and embedded release/staging authorities still cite 7becc573. Generated consumers can therefore select mutually inconsistent candidates from one otherwise valid JSON source.
evidence: fresh staging 14/14 and production 10/10 verifier output
context/PROJECT_STATUS.json lastVerification, source/artifact and structured release fields
items.constraint: One structured current candidate authority must own source revision, artifact, staging, production, backend applicability, visuals and performance; historical receipts remain append-only artifacts, never current aliases.
verification: a deterministic reconciler rejects disagreement and updates only from verified source receipts
PROJECT_STATUS current candidate fields agree after staging/promotion
tests fail when top-level, staging, production, visual or performance revisions diverge

L1.recipe: Refresh every current release field from the same verified staging/production receipts at closeout.

L2.recipe: Introduce one fail-closed release-authority reconciler that reads verified staging, production, visual and performance receipts, reports exact divergence, and writes PROJECT_STATUS current-candidate fields through the invariant writer.

L3.recipe: L2 plus signed immutable promotion receipts and automatic historical compaction that never changes current authority.
